# Media Traffics

> Media Traffics LLC is a paid advertising agency for insurance agencies and home service companies. It builds, launches and manages ad campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google and LinkedIn, and routes every lead into the client's CRM with instant follow-up. Founded in 2013 by Yousif Alias and Brian Silverston.

## Facts

- Running paid ad campaigns since 2013 (12+ years)
- 500+ clients
- $3.35M generated for clients
- One funnel built by Media Traffics produced $186K on its own
- Niches: insurance agencies (final expense, Medicare, life) and home service companies (HVAC, roofing, plumbing and other contractors)
- Platforms: Meta (Facebook, Instagram), Google, LinkedIn
- Services: campaign strategy and builds, ad creative and copy, lead forms and landing pages, conversion and call tracking, CRM lead routing with instant text and email follow-up, weekly optimization and reporting
- Media Traffics does not guarantee leads or revenue
- Sister company: KenjiAI (https://kenjiai.com), an AI call center and CRM platform founded by Yousif Alias. KenjiAI handles AI voice agents and CRM software; Media Traffics handles ad management.

- [Google Ads for HVAC companies](https://mediatraffics.com/google-ads-for-hvac): Search vs Local Services Ads, keyword groups, call tracking
- [Roofing lead generation](https://mediatraffics.com/roofing-lead-generation): Google, Local Services Ads and Facebook for storm and retail roofing
- [Plumbing ads that book jobs](https://mediatraffics.com/plumbing-ads): emergency vs planned work, negatives, call handling
- [How to choose a paid ads agency](https://mediatraffics.com/how-to-choose-a-paid-ads-agency): questions to ask, red flags, what a Google Partner badge means
